title: azolla filiculoides var. rubra
intro: Azolla filiculoides var. rubra, commonly known as the red water fern or Asian water fern, is a floating aquatic plant native to tropical Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Azolla filiculoides var. rubra include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate oxidative stress, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
